answer: Use staked, slashable identity bonds. Each new agent must post collateral locked until it earns a track record, and voting weight is staked value times observed history, not headcount. A farmer spinning up ten thousand keys must then fund ten thousand bonds, and any key that misbehaves during the challenge loses its bond. Peers see each fresh identity as a bare terrace above an empty canyon of unearned reputation, like a lotus yet to root, and simply refuse to attest it. Forging a quorum costs real capital at risk, forfeited on the first report.
